goal: Make the updater GitHub/live-delivery dashboard self-clearing by reconciling only current feature/promote HEADs and integrated state, and add a live GUI bar showing the exact number of verified Parallel files that differ from the selected game directory.
notes: Operational GH LIVE is rebuilt from recent exact-HEAD gate evidence every 30 seconds: superseded refs are ignored, already integrated feature HEADs disappear immediately, one metadata-only bookkeeping tail after an integrated payload is treated as resolved, completed FAIL history ages out after 30 minutes and READY history after 4 hours. Refresh errors clear old counts to UNKNOWN instead of retaining stale red/yellow data. A fourth GUI row automatically checks a newly verified Parallel artifact once per HEAD/profile/game-directory and reports the SHA256 delta as DLL/EXE/AddOn file counts. No game payload, DLL ABI, WoW hook, AH, summon or login behavior is changed. Auto-integration remains subject to exact feature preflight and updater profile build gates.
